<?php
trait Probe169Aliases {
    public static function m(int $value): int { return $value + 1; }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
}
$object = new class {
    use Probe169Aliases { m as q; Probe169Aliases::m as protected hidden; m as private privateAlias; }
    public static function run(int $value): int { return self::hidden($value) + self::privateAlias($value); }
};
$capture = $object::Y;
echo $capture(3), ':', $object::m(4), ':', $object::run(5), ';';
try { $object::hidden(0); echo 'BAD;'; } catch (Error $caught) { echo 'protected;'; }
try { $object::privateAlias(0); echo 'BAD;'; } catch (Error $caught) { echo 'private;'; }

<?php
class Probe169Base {}
trait Probe169Left {
    public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'left'; }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
}
trait Probe169Right { public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'right'; } }
trait Probe169Extra { public static function tag(): string { return 'extra'; } }
$object = new class extends Probe169Base {
    use Probe169Left, Probe169Right {
        Probe169Left::m insteadof Probe169Right;
        Probe169Right::m as public q;
        Probe169Left::m as protected hidden;
    }
    use Probe169Extra;
};
$capture = $object::Y;
$copy = clone $capture;
echo $object::m(new Probe169Base), ':', $capture(new Probe169Base), ':', $copy(new Probe169Base), ':', $object::tag(), ';';

<?php
interface Probe169I { public static function q(int $value): int; }
trait Probe169IT {
    public static function m(int $value): int { return $value + 1; }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
}
$object = new class implements Probe169I { use Probe169IT { Probe169IT::m as public q; } };
$capture = $object::Y;
echo $object instanceof Probe169I ? 'interface;' : 'BAD;';
echo $capture(2), ':', $object::q(4), ';';

<?php
trait Probe169Static { public static function m(): int { static $i = 0; return ++$i; } }
$object = new class { use Probe169Static { m as q; Probe169Static::m as r; } };
echo $object::m(), ':', $object::q(), ':', $object::r(), ':', $object::q(), ':', $object::m(), ';';

<?php
trait Probe169A { public static function m(): int { return 1; } }
trait Probe169B { public static function m(): int { return 2; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class { use Probe169A, Probe169B { Probe169A::m insteadof Probe169B; m as q; } };
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait Probe169A { public static function m(): int { return 1; } }
trait Probe169B { public static function m(): int { return 2; } }
echo 'before;';
if (false) { $object = new class { use Probe169A, Probe169B; }; }
echo 'after;';

<?php
interface Probe169I { public static function q(int $value): int; }
trait Probe169IT { public static function m(int $value): int { return $value; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class implements Probe169I { use Probe169IT { m as protected q; } };
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait Probe169A { public static function m(): int { return 1; } }
trait Probe169B { public static function m(): int { return 2; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class { use Probe169A, Probe169B; };
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait Probe169Final { private static function m(): int { return 1; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class { use Probe169Final { Probe169Final::m as final q; } public static function run(): int { return self::q(); } };
echo 'after:', $object::run(), ';';

<?php
trait Probe169D { public static function m(): int { static $i = 0; return ++$i; } }
$object = new class { use Probe169D { m as m; m as Q; m as q; m as private; m as public; } use Probe169D; };
echo $object::m(), ':', $object::Q(), ':', $object::q(), ':', $object::M(), ';';

<?php
namespace Probe169Space;
trait Left { public static function m(): string { return 'left'; } }
trait Right { public static function m(): string { return 'right'; } public const Y = self::q(...); }
namespace Probe169Caller;
use Probe169Space\Left as SourceL;
use Probe169Space\Right as SourceR;
$object = new class { use SourceL, SourceR { SourceL::m insteadof SourceR; SourceR::m as q; } };
$capture = $object::Y;
echo $object::m(), ':', $capture(), ';';

<?php
interface Probe169Both { public static function q(Probe169BothBase $value): string; }
class Probe169BothBase {}
trait Probe169BothL { public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'left'; } }
trait Probe169BothR { public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'right'; } public const Y = self::q(...); }
$object = new class extends Probe169BothBase implements Probe169Both { use Probe169BothL, Probe169BothR { Probe169BothL::m insteadof Probe169BothR; Probe169BothR::m as public q; } };
$capture = $object::Y;
echo $object instanceof Probe169Both ? 'interface;' : 'BAD;';
echo $capture(new Probe169BothBase), ';';

<?php
trait Probe169ArgA { public static function m(): int { return 1; } }
trait Probe169ArgB { public static function m(): int { return 2; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class(print('argument;')) { use Probe169ArgA, Probe169ArgB; };
echo 'BAD;';

<?php

trait Probe169S { public static function m(int $value): int { return $value; } }
echo 'before;';
$object = new class implements Probe169Nonstatic { use Probe169S { m as public q; } };

trait Probe169SigT { public static function m(string $value): int { return 1; } }
